item.title: Seattle weather: 5 PM sunsets return to western WA
item.description: After two weeks with no rainfall in our region, rain finally returns to the forecast Wednesday morning in Seattle.

item.title: MODHAUS’ 24-member boy group idntt expands with debut of second unit yesweare
item.description: Composed of three subunits, idntt, once fully formed, will be one of the largest male groups in K-pop, with 24 members.

item.title: Theory linking Seattle Seahawks Super Bowl trips to new pope elections holds up
item.description: The theory tracks. Every time a pope is elected, the Seahawks go to the Super Bowl.

item.title: Seattle police seek suspects in University District fatal stabbing
item.description: The Seattle Police Department is asking for the public's help to identify two suspects in a fatal stabbing in the University District on June 22, 2025.

item.title: King County, WA counts homeless population amid freezing overnight temperatures
item.description: King County has begun its federally required point-in-time count to estimate how many people are experiencing homelessness, coming as the region experiences freezing temperatures.

item.title: Treasured bible among stolen items returned after robbery in Pierce County, WA
item.description: Police arrested a man accused of targeting elderly women in robberies, now the victims are getting their belongings back, including a priceless Bible.

item.title: Gov. Ferguson, AG Brown write warning to DHS Secretary Kristi Noem
item.description: Washington’s Governor and Attorney General have a clear message for federal agents after the deadly shootings involving ICE officers in Minnesota.

item.title: Washington bill could outlaw selling nitrous oxide, 'whippets'
item.description: Lawmakers in Olympia want to ban retailers from selling any recreational device containing nitrous oxide, otherwise known as laughing gas or “whippets.”

item.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba has a star turn as he helps carry the Seahawks to the Super Bowl
item.description: Jaxon Smith-Njigba made plenty of spectacular plays during the best season by a receiver in Seahawks history, so it wasn't a shock that he added another highlight during the NFC championship game.

item.title: Man found dead in Kent, WA, homicide investigation launched
item.description: Kent police have launched a homicide investigation after a man was found dead in the brush.
